title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the publish batch's seed apply and its pending-declaration collection out of protocol.ts into protocol-publish-batch.ts (#25467 cut 14)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7JKgiM29GUcitRvoGGj5BU)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

Cut 14 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–13 landed as #25494, #25518, #25538, #25589, #25601, #25623, #25642, #25719, #25731, #25740, #25797, #25939 and #25972. The claim is `6410996628`; the scope is the cut 14 proposal of the cut 13 report, as the server seat approved it in its dispatch order, unnarrowed.

Two `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` members move unedited into a new module, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-publish-batch.ts` (#23050 shape B): the publish batch's seed apply `applySeedBodies` and the collection of the batch's own pending declarations `collectBatchPendingDeclarations`. `protocol.ts` loses 132 net lines (29,620 to 29,488). The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread, restarted from `main` `0479cd6a0a` after cut 13 merged. It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record. It holds the move commit `c2c08b1ae` and two merges of `main` (`4003f5015` with `05f7758f0`, `721669cb1` with `a4eae0649`). Neither merge touches `packages/metadata-protocol/`: the package's `src/` tree is `941b828d` at `0479cd6a0a`, at `a4eae0649` and at the base of this diff.

**Serial with the file's in-flight PRs.** Measured just before this PR was opened: of the 20 open PRs, two touch `packages/metadata-protocol/src/`, and neither touches `protocol.ts` or the new module. #25989 edits `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` (behaviour, no by-path read) and #25986 edits `protocol-package-install.ts` and its test.

## What moves

| Member | Base line | Visibility | Body lines | AST tokens (params + return + body) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `applySeedBodies` | `:23330` | private | 79 | 400 |
| `collectBatchPendingDeclarations` | `:23526` | private | 71 | 258 |

150 body lines (the order's estimate was about 146).

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1–13 apply it)

- **The class keeps every member** with its name, docblock, signature and position. Each body is now one host literal plus a `.call`, marked `[#25467 cut 14]`.
- **Typing.** `PublishBatchHost` types every member as the class member itself (an indexed access on `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`). Each moved function types its `this` as the `Pick` of the host over exactly the members its body reads. Each stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType` of `typeof fn`. No member changes visibility.
- **Members read, measured by AST walk** (property and element accesses on `this`, with `as` casts and parentheses stripped):
  - `applySeedBodies` reads `engine` (a live getter) and `getMetaItem` (a closure). **The `getMetaItem` read was not in the proposal.** The body spells it `(this as any).getMetaItem(...)` inside the loader's metadata adapter, so a `this.NAME` screen does not see it. Without it in the host, the adapter would call `undefined` at runtime while `tsc` stayed green (the `any` cast hides it). The closure calls `getMetaItem` on the protocol at call time, so a spy set on the instance is still the one the adapter reaches.
  - `collectBatchPendingDeclarations` reads `getOverlayRepo` and `warnClosureReadUnavailable`, both as closures.
- **What stays.** `warnClosureReadUnavailable` stays in the class, as the order said: it writes the instance field `closureReadWarned`. Neither moved body reads a private-static member: the AST walk found no access on the `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` identifier and none on `this.constructor`, in either body.
- **Every other caller still calls the class method.** `runPublishSideEffects` and `publishPackageDrafts` call `applySeedBodies`; `publishPackageDrafts` calls `collectBatchPendingDeclarations`.

## Module-level declarations, by reader

- **Two gain `export` in place, none moves.** `declaresClientRefusal` (read by `applySeedBodies`' catch) and `memberOption` (read by `collectBatchPendingDeclarations`). `canonicalMetaType`, `clientFacingFailureText` and `seedRequestValidationError` were already exported. None is re-exported from `index.ts`, so the package's export table does not change (below).
- **Imports.** `CLOSURE_CONTEXT_KEY_BY_TYPE` loses its last reader in `protocol.ts` and leaves the `./runtime-authoring-gate.js` import; the new module imports it from there, beside the type `RuntimePendingDeclarations`. The body's two dynamic imports (`./seed-loader.js`, `@objectstack/spec/data`) move unchanged and resolve from the same directory. The one new statement in `protocol.ts` is the import of the new module. The new module's runtime import from `./protocol.js` is the cycle earlier modules already use (`protocol-batch-data.ts`, `protocol-drafts.ts`, `protocol-publish-backfill.ts` among them): it reads only function declarations, and only at call time.

## The published `.d.ts`

The series bar is ruling `6348891160`, sorted-union identity, measured first. Base and head were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree: the closure built at head by a full `pnpm build` (119/119), then the package's `src/` swapped tree-only to `0479cd6a0a` for the base build and restored from `HEAD` under a trap (`git diff HEAD` empty, `git status` clean and both touched blobs equal to `HEAD`'s after). Measured twice: on the pre-merge tree (base `0479cd6a0a`, head `c2c08b1ae`) and after merging `main` (head `4003f5015`, closure rebuilt by a full `pnpm build`, 119/119). The readings below hold for both.

- **Raw sha256**: `08914e65f936a2b031c3f3f215481a97f53d132eefd869e4f42d928947ebe173` at base and at head, on both `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`, 775,874 bytes each. **Raw identity holds**, so sorted-union identity holds too. Both members stay `private NAME;` lines.
- **Normalised sha256**: `46ccd7e5c4db673652513d1801ec9c9f06bf34a0a7fb6ba97fb2531ef0cc544b` at both ends (80 string-literal union runs sorted; the cut 12 normaliser).
- **The two builds differ where they should**: `index.js` hashes `46f350a33fcbf439…` at base and `a63f0a4b6b52b222…` at head; each function's `.call(host` site occurs 0 times in the base bundles and once in the head bundles (ESM and CJS alike).
- **Positive control** on the head tree (on disk, restored from `HEAD` under a trap, hash equal to `HEAD`'s after): `private` dropped from `applySeedBodies` and the package rebuilt. Both `.d.ts` files move to `a0203ce8529250b7…` and print the member's full signature (`applySeedBodies(bodies: unknown[]): Promise<{ success: boolean; inserted: number; … }>`), so the bar can see a change on these members.
- **Export tables.** The ESM and CJS bundles, loaded at runtime from the package, each export the same 78 names at base and head; the sorted list hashes to `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on all four. Neither moved function, the host type, `declaresClientRefusal`, `memberOption` nor `CLOSURE_CONTEXT_KEY_BY_TYPE` appears.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## Proof of move-only

**Bodies, by AST token** (the TypeScript compiler's AST leaf tokens, JSDoc skipped, over parameters less the added `this`, return type and body), base `protocol.ts` at `0479cd6a0a` against the head module:

```
applySeedBodies: base tokens 400, head tokens 400, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
collectBatchPendingDeclarations: base tokens 258, head tokens 258, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
TOTAL tokens=658 differ=0 members=2
CLASS members base=300 head=300 order-same=true byte-identical=298 stubs-with-identical-docblock+signature=2 other=[]
TOP base=242 head=243 byte-identical=239
```

**Negative control**, one token changed in an in-memory copy of the head module (`seeds.length === 0` to `seeds.length !== 0`, one occurrence):

```
MUTATED packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-publish-batch.ts "seeds.length === 0" -> "seeds.length !== 0"
applySeedBodies: base tokens 400, head tokens 400, differ 1, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) false
collectBatchPendingDeclarations: base tokens 258, head tokens 258, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
TOTAL tokens=658 differ=1 members=2
```

- **Class side.** 300 members at base and at head, in the same order. The 298 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading comments included. Each of the 2 stubs sits at its base position and keeps its docblock and signature byte-identical (everything before the body's opening brace).
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`.** 239 of the 242 base statements are byte-identical, leading comments included. The other three: the `./runtime-authoring-gate.js` import losing `CLOSURE_CONTEXT_KEY_BY_TYPE`, and `memberOption` and `declaresClientRefusal` gaining `export`. Head adds one statement, the new module's import.
- **Size.** +240 / −148 over 2 files, 388 changed lines (the order's estimate was 350–420). `protocol-publish-batch.ts` has 224 lines.

## Readers of the moved lines

The seven test files the cut 13 report named were re-grepped by path for both member names. None reads `protocol.ts` by path (no `readFileSync`, no `protocol.ts` path literal); none names `collectBatchPendingDeclarations`.

| File | Hits | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| metadata-protocol `protocol.batch-verb-driver-text.test.ts` | 49 (comment); 315, 631, 661, 704 call `protocol.applySeedBodies(...)` | Behaviour through the class method, which the stub keeps. Passes at both ends. |
| objectql `build-probes.test.ts` | 200, `vi.spyOn(protocol, 'applySeedBodies')` | The spy replaces the class method, which is what callers reach. Passes at head. |
| objectql `protocol-publish-package-drafts.test.ts` | 418–512 spies; 518–571 direct calls with the real `SeedLoaderService` | Spies as above. The real-loader smoke test runs the moved body end to end, including the `getMetaItem` adapter read. Passes at head. |
| objectql `publish-package-drafts-response-conformance.test.ts` | 283 (comment) | No edit owed. Passes at head. |
| runtime `packages-publish-drafts-response-conformance.test.ts` | 215 (comment) | No edit owed. Passes at head. |
| runtime `packages-seed-apply-disclosure.test.ts` | 8 (comment) | No edit owed. Passes at head. |
| spec `api/protocol.test.ts` | 1291 (comment) | No edit owed (the comment names the producer, not its file). |

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json:2880` anchors `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts#applySeedBodies+`. The method keeps its name in `protocol.ts`; `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` judges it (see Verification).
- Every other test or script that reads `protocol.ts` by path and names a symbol the bodies use (`protocol.hydrate-overlay-canonical-type`, `protocol.read-verb-canonical-fold`, `protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites`, `protocol.register-item-call-sites`, `protocol.object-registry-write-through-spelling`, `protocol.view-expansion-reconcile-call-sites`) ran in the package suite and passes at both ends; `check-durability-degradation-log-level` ran as a hand gate (below).
- **Bracketed-refusal pin** (`PRODUCERS`): the moved bodies construct no error (0 `new Error(`, 0 `new TypeError(`; `applySeedBodies` throws the `seedRequestValidationError(...)` it calls, which is built in `protocol.ts`). No row is owed, as the order said.
- **ADR anchors and decision letters.** `check-adr-anchors` exits 0 at both ends: 86 anchored files, 58,982 citations, files 8,267 → 8,268, and **1,844 → 1,843** decision-letter citations. The one that leaves the anchored file is the `[ADR-0131 D6, §12]` comment in `applySeedBodies`' body (`protocol.ts` `ADR-0131 D6` 114 → 113). The `protocol.ts` anchor does not cover ADR-0131, and no entry paragraph describes the seed apply, so the new module gets no entry (disclosure only, as cuts 8, 12 and 13).
- **Durability checker**: `check-durability-degradation-log-level` exits 0 at both ends with identical output, and its `--list` is identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped (159 lines).
- **Engine-double contract** (`check-engine-double-contract`): exits 0 at both ends. The `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (14085 → 14086, 14110 → 14111). `productionFiles` is 3,710 at base and 3,712 at head: +1 is the new file, +1 is the gitignored `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`, which the spec build writes in the head tree and the clean base tree had not built.
- **Identical output at both ends:** `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet`, `check-filter-alias-parity`. `check-nul-bytes` differs only in the scanned file count, +1. The base-end readings were taken in a clean detached worktree at `0479cd6a0a`.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-ybjm3h`: 0 of 2 paths hit the register, NOT governed; 388 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge bar.

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 before and after the merges. `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol` (the whole touched package; it has no `lint` script, these are the root `lint` script's flags) exits 0, no output.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol` suite**, base and head, compared per test name and status (vitest `--maxWorkers=2`, JSON reporter, each run under the shared verify lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0` both legs), on the pre-merge tree (the merges changed no file of the package):
  - Base `0479cd6a0a`: 21,553 tests (21,534 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 268 files.
  - Head `c2c08b1ae`: 21,553 tests (21,534 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 268 files.
  - None lost, none added, none changed status. The base leg is the package `src/` swapped tree-only from `0479cd6a0a` (the new module removed from the tree) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap.
- **Cross-package readers**, at head under the verify lock: objectql `build-probes`, `protocol-publish-package-drafts`, `publish-package-drafts-response-conformance`: 3 files, 43/43 passed, exit 0. runtime `packages-publish-drafts-response-conformance`, `packages-seed-apply-disclosure`: 2 files, 16/16 passed, exit 0.
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` (merged tree): OK, 1 anchored file in the change set, 29 anchors judged, 0 lost. That includes `platform-core.json`'s `protocol.ts#applySeedBodies+`.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 53 gates on 2 changed paths from the merged tree `721669cb1`, with no stale-tree warning; all 53 exit 0 after the full `pnpm build` (119/119). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 53 derived, 53 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0. (Cut 13 derived 59: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` changed on `main` between the two cuts.)

## Acceptance notes

- **A docblock that now reads narrower than the code.** `clientFacingFailureText`'s docblock (which ships in the `.d.ts`) says "`declaresClientRefusal` stays private on purpose: nothing outside this file needs the raw predicate". This cut exports it from `protocol.ts` because the moved catch reads it. Its purpose still holds at the package boundary: `index.ts` does not re-export it and the export table is unchanged. The sentence was left as it is, because editing it would change the `.d.ts` this series holds byte-identical. Rewording it to "outside this package" can ride a later cut that already moves `.d.ts` text, or a docs-only PR.
- The proposal said `applySeedBodies` reads `engine` only. The AST walk with casts stripped found the `(this as any).getMetaItem` read too; the cut 15 screen below uses the same walk.

## Carry-forward

Unchanged from cut 13: public members whose return type is inferred, the bodies kept by a reader (`probeRecord`, `getMetaItemCached`, `findReferencesToMeta`, `packagelessAddress`, `refuseUnmintableMetaType`, `metaTypeNamespaceExists`, `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` with `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad`, the 7 `applyRegistryWriteThrough` callers, `readCodeLayerForCarryForward`), and the private-static readers (`refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, `packagedBaseRefusal`, `runPublishSideEffects`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `publishPackageDrafts`, `discardPackageDrafts`) stay in `protocol.ts`. Added this cut: `warnClosureReadUnavailable`, which writes an instance field.
